fact_text: Airlink reported 1QFY26 consolidated earnings of PKR 4.1 per share, up about 88% year on year and down about 16% quarter on quarter.

fact_text: Airlink's 1QFY26 net sales were about PKR 24.4 billion, up about 30%, with the presenter noting a low base effect from the prior quarter.
